svg.title: pocgate architecture
svg.desc: Architecture blueprint: the CLI dispatches to spec, exec, oracle, regress, verdict, evidence and demo. spec owns the pocgate.yaml schema and rejects unknown fields. exec is the only module that touches processes. oracle runs each PoC N times and classifies FIRED, SILENT or UNOBSERVED. regress extracts failures from an exit code or from junit_xml on stdout. verdict turns three observations into four states and exit codes, applying the patch in a scratch copy. evidence writes canonical JSON with sha256 and ed25519. Only three things touch disk: baseline.json, evidence/latest.json with its .pub, and a local 0600 private key.

svg.text: No server, no database, no network. The process boundary exists once.
